description: Header file defining interfaces, macros, data structures, and constants for ESP Wi-Fi AT command driver in Zephyr RTOS, including socket management, configuration macros, and external references.

classes.name: esp_socket
classes.description: Represents a Wi-Fi socket with associated state, synchronization primitives, and callback handlers.

classes.name: esp_data
classes.description: Main driver data structure holding network interface, socket array, modem context, and synchronization primitives.

methods.name: esp_offload_init
methods.description: Initializes the ESP Wi-Fi offload driver for a given network interface.

methods.name: esp_socket_get
methods.description: Retrieves a socket structure associated with a specific network context.

methods.name: esp_socket_put
methods.description: Decrements reference count and potentially frees the socket.

methods.name: esp_socket_init
methods.description: Initializes socket-related data structures within the driver.

methods.name: esp_socket_close
methods.description: Closes a socket and releases resources.

methods.name: esp_socket_rx
methods.description: Handles received data on a socket.

methods.name: esp_socket_workq_stop_and_flush
methods.description: Stops and flushes the work queue associated with a socket.

methods.name: esp_socket_ref
methods.description: Increments reference count for a socket.

methods.name: esp_socket_unref
methods.description: Decrements reference count for a socket.

methods.name: esp_socket_ref_from_link_id
methods.description: Retrieves a socket based on link ID.

methods.name: esp_socket_flags_update
methods.description: Atomically updates socket flags.

methods.name: esp_socket_flags_clear_and_set
methods.description: Clears and sets specific socket flags atomically.

methods.name: esp_socket_flags_set
methods.description: Sets specific socket flags.

methods.name: esp_socket_flags_test_and_clear
methods.description: Tests and clears socket flags atomically.

methods.name: esp_socket_flags_test_and_set
methods.description: Tests and sets socket flags atomically.

methods.name: esp_socket_flags_clear
methods.description: Clears specific socket flags.

methods.name: esp_socket_flags
methods.description: Retrieves current socket flags.

methods.name: esp_socket_to_dev
methods.description: Converts a socket pointer to the main driver data structure.

methods.name: __esp_socket_work_submit
methods.description: Submits work to the socket's work queue.

methods.name: esp_socket_work_submit
methods.description: Submits work to the socket's work queue with locking.

methods.name: esp_socket_queue_tx
methods.description: Queues a packet for transmission on a socket.

methods.name: esp_socket_connected
methods.description: Checks if a socket is connected.

methods.name: esp_flags_set
methods.description: Sets flags in the main driver data.

methods.name: esp_flags_clear
methods.description: Clears flags in the main driver data.

methods.name: esp_flags_are_set
methods.description: Checks if specific flags are set in the main driver data.

methods.name: esp_socket_type
methods.description: Returns the socket type.

methods.name: esp_socket_ip_proto
methods.description: Returns the IP protocol used by the socket.

methods.name: esp_cmd_send
methods.description: Sends a command to the modem with handling and timeout.

methods.name: esp_connect_work
methods.description: Work handler for establishing connection.

methods.name: esp_recvdata_work
methods.description: Work handler for processing received data.

methods.name: esp_close_work
methods.description: Work handler for closing socket.

methods.name: esp_send_work
methods.description: Work handler for sending data.
